scale_measurement.scope: Synthetic text sources, this browser profile and build host, not a phone performance claim.

environment: Windows build host; isolated Chrome at 390px; synthetic evidence and media. Public provider queries were real and generic.
limits: No physical iPhone or Safari model/codec acceptance.
No actual model inference, citation entailment benchmark or campaign uplift.
Crossref and Wikipedia discovery are bounded public search connectors, not unrestricted web or social-platform research.
No private Sanctum content, shared ChatGPT tools/memory, paid fallback, cloud data service or desktop relay.

publication.line_endings: Publication retains exact Windows build bytes. CR at EOL is accepted; other source whitespace checks remain enabled.
